pc_changelog:
v6.0.0 — Ultimate Commercial Release & Power Features (Lag & Performance Fixes)

• Fixed: Global C# startup, launch, and UI lag when summoning (Alt+C)
• Fixed: 10x image memory footprint reduction (optimizing decoded thumbnails to 250px)
• Fixed: Non-blocking diagnostic capturing and background theme color extraction
• Added: Bulk Image Merging directly into PDF from the toolbar with auto-conversion
• Added: Google Search and Text-to-PDF formatting directly in the context menu
• Added: Gemini AI-powered Table Extraction integration to the main shelf
• Added: Store-compliant passive shake background polling (0% overhead, spyware-free)
• Fixed: Perfect toolbar layout alignment for Emoji and Merge buttons
android_changelog:
v6.0.0 — Mixed Merger, Safe Mode & Emulator Support

• Added: Dual-architecture support (arm64-v8a + x86_64 emulators)
• Added: On-device image-to-PDF conversion and mixed PDF/image merging via pure JS
• Added: Robust JS Error Boundary and premium Safe Mode diagnostic recovery UI
• Added: Left-aligned card type icons and Google Search shortcut for text cards
• Added: Dynamic image aspect-ratio scaling and safe scrollbar spacing
